mcp_tools.name: production_rust_engineering_pack
mcp_tools.title: Production rust engineering pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a production Rust engineering record (ownership and lifetimes, error handling, unsafe policy with declared unsafe-block rows, async runtime, testing, tooling, workspace and supply chain, red lines) and returns a deterministic PRODUCTION_RUST_ENGINEERING_PACK_READY / PRODUCTION_RUST_ENGINEERING_PACK_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed unsafe-block invariant and test-coverage checks over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared engineering record only; it compiles nothing and reviews no repository.

inputSchema.description: The production rust engineering pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

testing: the error paths are tested
testing: criterion is used for benchmarks

clippy gate: cargo fmt --check is clean
clippy gate: lints are fixed, not silenced without reason
workspaces: crates are split only when boundaries are real
workspaces: feature flags are kept minimal — no default bloat

supply chain: new crates are reviewed before adoption
red line: no blocking work inside the async runtime is present in the record
red line: no unbounded channels are present in the record
red line: no spawn-loops without backpressure are present in the record
